heading.title: Suits by or against the government or public officers in their official capacity

article.title: Attendance of person able to answer questions relating to suit against Government.
article.content: The Court may also, in any case in which the 1[Government pleader] is not accompanied by any person on the part of 2[the Government] who may be able to answer any material questions relating to the suit, direct the attendance of such a person.
article.html:
6Attendance of person able to answer questions relating to suit against Government.

Order 27, Rule 6

The Court may also, in any case in which the 1[Government pleader] is not accompanied by any person on the part of 2[the Government] who may be able to answer any material questions relating to the suit, direct the attendance of such a person.

1 Subs. by the A.O. 1950, for “Crown pleader” which had been subs. by the A. O. 1937, for “Government pleader”.

2 Subs. by the A.O. 1937, for “the Secretary of State for India in Council”.
